title: Voyager map file
description: A racecourse: spawn, rings in race order, the racing line and the boost tuning. Describes the format the catalogue adapters in voyager-platform read. The loader does not validate against this document at runtime; the adapters are the runtime check. Derived fields: a ring's index defaults to its position in rings, and world defaults to the value of key.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, so editors can find it.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the file format this file is written in. Absent means 1. This schema describes version 3, the version that states an oval ring; versions 1 and 2 are described by map-v1.schema.json and map-v2.schema.json.

key.description: The map's identifier: elytrarace:<value>, where the value is lower case letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, at most 32 characters. Statistics and operator commands name the map by this key.

authors.description: The players who built the map, at most eight, none repeated. Optional. Shown as data, never translated.

displayName.description: The name players read, in place of the map's id. Optional; absent or blank means the id. Shown as plain text, never translated.

world.description: The world directory under the worlds path. Optional; when absent it is the name, exactly as written.

referenceTimeSeconds.description: The lap time, in seconds, a new record must beat.

rings.description: The rings in race order. Ring i is the ring at position i.

notes.description: Free text for the person editing the file. Ignored by the loader.

uuid.description: The player's UUID in the canonical 8-4-4-4-12 form, in either letter case.

name.description: The player's name, as a Minecraft username is written. Kept as written; not looked up at load.

index.description: Optional. When present it must equal the ring's position in rings; a mismatch refuses the file. Left out, the position is used.

normal.description: The unit normal of the disc. Its sign decides which way through the ring counts.

radius.description: The radius of a circle, in blocks, or the semi-major radius of an oval. From 0.5 to 32.

radiusMinor.description: Optional. The semi-minor radius of an oval, in blocks, from 0.5 to 32 and not greater than radius. Stated together with majorAxis; equal to radius, the ring is a circle.

majorAxis.description: Optional. The unit vector of the oval's major axis, in the ring's plane. Stated together with radiusMinor.

points.description: The score for passing this ring, from 0 to 100.

cooldownTicks.description: Must be longer than burnDurationTicks; the loader refuses it otherwise. The cooldown is measured from the tick a boost starts, so it must outlast the burn.

rocketsPerRacer.description: How many rockets a racer is given when the map begins. Optional; 64, the item stack limit, when absent. Every rocket burns for burnDurationTicks and the item's flight duration is derived from that burn.

maxSpeedBlocksPerTick.description: Optional speed cap in blocks per tick. It limits only the velocity a BOOST or SLOW ring writes, and keeps its direction. It never limits normal flight or rockets. Absent means no cap.

ringEffects.description: Optional. The velocity factors of this map's BOOST and SLOW rings. A factor that is left out keeps its default: 1.5 for BOOST, 0.5 for SLOW.

boostMultiplier.description: The factor a BOOST ring multiplies the racer's velocity by. Zero or more.

slowMultiplier.description: The factor a SLOW ring multiplies the racer's velocity by. Zero or more.

lookAheadRings.description: How many rings ahead the racing line is shown.

particleSpacing.description: Blocks between drawn particles on the racing line. The loader refuses less than 0.25.

mode.description: Optional. FULL draws the line from the ring the racer is heading for to the last ring, and is the default. WINDOW draws only lookAheadRings rings ahead.

particle.description: Optional. The particle the line is drawn with. END_ROD is the default.

dustColor.description: Optional. The colour of a DUST line, as #RRGGBB. Default #FFC800. The loader refuses it unless particle is DUST.

orderIndex.description: Where the point sits on the line, in steps of 100 per ring. A multiple of 100 is a ring's own slot, which the loader refuses.
